The outcome is clear: only one option gives you permanent ownership and control.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Plugins online

Renting platforms like Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad offer convenience but no sovereignty. They handle payments, delivery, and compliance—until they don’t. Custom solutions built on WordPress or Shopify provide flexibility but require constant maintenance and technical expertise. Sovereign commerce stacks, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197), deploy base-layer infrastructure you own: Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for logic, Supabase for storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Full ownership from day one.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal exclude entire countries based on compliance or risk assessments. Even if available, accounts can be suspended arbitrarily, as seen in Nigeria and Pakistan. Custom solutions may work but rely on local payment gateways with high fees or unreliable service. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. Your store operates on infrastructure you control, immune to platform restrictions or geopolitical risk.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Platforms charge 2.9% to 5% per transaction, plus additional fees for international sales. Custom solutions incur hosting, development, and maintenance costs. Sovereign stacks cut fees to the bone. NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is fixed, with no hidden charges. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain instantly, triggering automatic delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Your real cost is a one-time deployment fee—no recurring subscriptions.
Platforms exclude countries. Sovereign stacks exclude no one.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms own your customer data, payment history, and delivery process. Custom solutions give you control but require manual updates and patches. Sovereign stacks deliver full ownership. Once deployed, COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure. Orders store in your Supabase database. Files deliver from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation runs on your Cloudflare Workers. Your stack is a self-sustaining machine—no platform can shut it down or change the rules.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you operate in a Stripe-excluded country or face PayPal suspensions, renting platforms is not an option. Custom solutions work but require ongoing technical investment. Sovereign commerce stacks are the only architecture built for permanent ownership and resilience. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours, fully configured and end-to-end tested. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure designed for creators who need to own their commerce stack, not rent it.

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, deploy a sovereign commerce stack. Use Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. This architecture bypasses platform restrictions entirely. Payments confirm on-chain instantly, triggering automatic file delivery. You own the entire stack—no platform dependency, no recurring fees.

Explore all stacks and blueprints at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This is not a temporary fix—it’s infrastructure sovereignty built to outlast platform restrictions.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
